lines.0: Namaste Aarav! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket score jaise 1 se 9 aur zero likhenge. Tumhe batting pasand hai ya bowling?
lines.1: Batting! Score wali cricket baat end mein phir karenge. Pehle socho: ek run ko kaunsa numeral dikhayega?
lines.2: Haan, one run ka numeral 1 hota hai. Screen par 3 dots hain—unhe gin kar batao, kaunsa numeral chahiye?
lines.3: Bilkul, 3 birds ke liye numeral 3. Ab sab birds udd gaye—kitne birds bache?
lines.4: Ab tumne birds ko ginkar khaali group samjha. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.5: Minus ka matlab ghataana hota hai. Jab sab birds udd jaate hain, group khaali hota hai—usse zero kehte hain. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is lef
lines.6: Chalo, objects ko ek-ek karke hatao aur har baar gino; khaali group par rukna hai. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.7: Ab number ko dekhkar uska naam bolna hai. Dhyaan se card padho. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.8: Tumne taaliyon ko gina. Ab wahi sankhya apni ungliyon par dikhao. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.9: Aarav, ungliyon par ek-ek taali gin kar dikhao. Card par diye choices mein se apni pasand ka chuno. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.10: Aarav, tumhe kaise pata chala ki yeh 4 hai?
lines.11: Haan, tumne chaar taali gin kar 4 pehchaana. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.12: Aarav, dono haath milao: ek poora haath aur doosre haath se kuch ungliyan. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.13: Haan, tumne ek poora haath aur doosre haath ki teen ungliyan dikhayi hain. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.14: Yes, 5 and 3 make eight; its numeral is 8, not 6 or 9. Tum 8 kaise likhoge?

lines.2: Bilkul, 64 se 100 tak 36 chahiye. Ab 46 se 100 tak kitna jump hoga?
lines.3: Vihaan beta, 46 se 100 tak bada jump banane ke liye pehle 46 se 50 tak chhota jump socho. Kahan pahunchoge?
lines.4: Haan, 46 se tum 50 par pahunch gaye. Khaali jagah bharo: Jump to the next ten: 46 to 50 is ___.
lines.5: Cricket mein tumne chhota jump 4 bilkul sahi bataya. Tumhare paas ₹80 hain. ₹100 banane ke liye aur kitne chahiye?
lines.6: Theek hai, Vihaan beta. Number line par 80 se aage 100 tak jumps ginne ko taiyaar ho jao. Tumhare paas ₹80 hain. ₹100 banane ke liye aur kitne chahiye?
lines.7: Haan Vihaan beta, tumne 20 bataya tha. Tumne 80 se 100 tak ka gap pehchana—ab batao, tumne kaise jaana?
lines.8: Bilkul—tumne partner method lagaya: 80 ka partner 20 hai. Ab 73 ka partner 100 ke liye kitna hoga?
lines.9: Sahi, Vihaan beta—tumne 73 se 100 tak ka gap 27 pakda. Dekho: 70 + 30 = 100 aur 75 + 25 = 100. Pehle mein dahaai 7 aur 3 hain, doosre mein 7 aur 2 kyun?
lines.10: Tumne ones place ke gap ko sahi dekha: 5 ko 100 tak 25 chahiye. 30 aur kitna milake 100 banta hai?
lines.11: Haan, 30 mein 70 jodne par 100 banta hai. 100 banane ke liye 60 ko aur kitna chahiye?
lines.12: Bilkul sahi—tumne 60 se 100 tak ka gap 40 bataya. ₹38 ki toffee ka packet liya aur ₹100 ka note diya. Kitne paise wapas milenge?
lines.13: Tumne 38 se 100 tak ginti karke gap nikala. ₹38 ki toffee ka packet liya aur ₹100 ka note diya. Kitne paise wapas milenge?
lines.14: Tumne kaha ki 100 mein se 38 ghataana hai; number line par 38 se 100 tak jumps gino—kitne? ₹38 ki toffee ka packet liya aur ₹100 ka note diya. Kitne paise wapas

lines.9: Aapne 42 ke baad teen zero lagaye; ab 42 ke baad wahi teen zero jodkar poora product boliye.
lines.10: Aapko space ke stars aur planets pasand hain—jaise distance estimate karte hain, waise 42 ke baad teen zero: 42,000. Bolkar dekhiye.
lines.11: Haan, 42 ke baad teen zero se 42,000 hota hai, 24,000 nahi. Ab cricket tickets wale numbers round karke batayiye. Ek cricket club 6,180 tickets ₹480 mein bechta
lines.12: 6,180 ko nearest thousand tak sochiye; ab apni calculation poori kijiye.
lines.13: Aapne 6 guna 5 ko 30 nikala; ab 6,000 aur 500 ke zeros gin kar final estimate bataiye.
lines.14: 6,000 mein 3 zero aur 500 mein 2 zero hain; 30 ke baad kul 5 zero lagenge. “Teen crore hazaar” nahi, ise lakhon mein boliye. 6,180 ko nearest thousand aur ₹480
